setup.name: setup
setup.title: Connect Supaflow
setup.summary: Connect a Supaflow account, select a workspace, and inspect existing connections without changing resources.
setup.description: Use when connecting or reconnecting the hosted Supaflow plugin, selecting a workspace, or checking onboarding readiness. Verifies identity and lists existing connections read-only. Does not create pipelines, install Native Apps, or manage local agents. Triggers: connect Supaflow, reconnect Supaflow, choose workspace, Supaflow onboarding, check connections.
setup.prompt: Connect to Supaflow, show my workspaces, and let me choose one. Keep setup read-only.
setup.author: Supaflow LLC

using-supaflow.name: using-supaflow
using-supaflow.title: Operate Supaflow Pipelines
using-supaflow.summary: Prepare, run, monitor, and troubleshoot ETL pipelines and dbt Core workflows through hosted Supaflow MCP tools.
using-supaflow.description: Use when preparing, running, monitoring, scheduling, or troubleshooting Supaflow ETL pipelines and dbt Core workflows. Uses the connected hosted Supaflow MCP server and the selected workspace. Does not administer local agents or install Native Apps. Triggers: Supaflow pipeline, Salesforce to Snowflake, dbt Core workflow, monitor ETL job, schedule pipeline, troubleshoot sync.
using-supaflow.prompt: Plan a Salesforce-to-Snowflake pipeline for Accounts, then ask me before creating it.
using-supaflow.author: Supaflow LLC
